basics.name: Badroudine Bacar
basics.title: AI / Machine Learning Engineer (Stage PFE)
basics.summary: Élève-ingénieur en dernière année à l'EILCO (spécialité IA), doté d'une certification TOEIC 905/990 (Niveau C1). Spécialisé en Deep Learning, NLP et vision par ordinateur, avec une expertise en conception de pipelines RAG, agents LLM et espaces vectoriels sémantiques. Développeur d'APIs haute performance sous FastAPI et conteneurisation Docker. Disponible en mars 2027 pour un stage de fin d'études de 6 mois.

education.institution: EILCO (École d'Ingénieurs du Littoral Côte d'Opale)
education.degree: Diplôme d'Ingénieur Informatique — Parcours Intelligence Artificielle
education.details: Dernière année (ING3). Modules avancés : Deep Learning, Vision par Ordinateur, Machine Learning, Architecture Logicielle, MLOps, CI/CD, Bases de Données Avancées.

education.degree: Classes Préparatoires aux Grandes Écoles (CPGE TSI)
education.details: Formation intensive pluridisciplinaire : Mathématiques fondamentales, Physique appliquée, Sciences de l'Ingénieur et Algorithmique.

experience.role: Founder & Lead Software Developer (Entrepreneurial Internship PÉPITE)
experience.description: Conception et développement complet d'une application mobile d'optimisation de consommation et détection de promotions.
highlights: Engineered on-device Computer Vision pipelines using Google ML Kit Text Recognition (OCR) for real-time document and label extraction.
Architected a serverless backend on Google Cloud Firestore and Cloud Functions (TypeScript) ensuring low-latency data synchronization.

projects.name: Antigravity — Autonomous LLM & RAG Pipeline
projects.description: Automated job-matching and document-generation pipeline powered by Gemini API and structured schemas.
highlights: Engineered an automated job-matching and document-generation pipeline using Google Gemini API, structured JSON schemas, and few-shot prompting to enforce 100% LaTeX compilation compliance without hallucinations.
Built automated validation and context-extraction layers to parse unstructured job descriptions and align candidate profiles against target technical requirements.

projects.name: VectorWord / Guess-What — Semantic Search Engine
projects.description: Interactive semantic search application leveraging word vector spaces.
highlights: Architected a FastAPI inference backend computing cosine similarity across multilingual Word2Vec vector spaces with in-memory model caching.
Containerized and deployed the full-stack application using Docker, Railway, Next.js 15, and Supabase for real-time state synchronization.

projects.name: EILCO Project Management & Scheduling Platform (PIC)
projects.description: Academic scheduling and grade processing backend.
highlights: Designed the relational SQL database schema and backend ingestion pipeline to parse legacy Excel academic records and automate defense scheduling and grade exports.

projects.name: Draw1 — Full-Stack Card Game Simulator
projects.description: Card game rules and simulation backend.
highlights: Built a RESTful API in C# (.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, SQLite) with Swagger documentation, integrated with an Angular frontend and Godot simulation client.
